title: Large gap between self-supervised and supervised pre-training
description: Initial self-supervised pre-training experiments on masked patch prediction show improvement over training from scratch, but a large gap remains compared to large-scale supervised pre-training.
canonical_description: self-supervised pre-training still lags behind supervised pre-training by a large margin

evidence.quote: With self-supervised pre-training, our smaller \oursabbrv-B/16 model achieves 79.9\% accuracy on \imagenet{}, a significant improvement of 2\% to training from scratch, but still 4\% behind supervised pre-training.
